# Week 7: memory
Built a study helper that remembers which lecture topics I got wrong.
Compared no memory vs. naive memory (append everything). Did not get to selective memory.
Naive memory felt better but I did not measure it.
agents2026-demo-a.week-10/README.md:
# Week 10: single vs multi-agent
Planner + quizzer + grader agents for the study helper.
The multi-agent version is slower. I did not run the single-agent version on the same questions, so I can't say which is better.
agents2026-demo-a.final-project/PROPOSAL.md:
# Final project proposal (presented week 8)
## Idea
A study companion that quizzes me from my own lecture notes and remembers what I keep getting wrong.
## Why
Re-reading notes doesn't work for me.
## Plan
Reuse my week 7 memory agent. Add a quiz generator.
## Evaluation
TBD. Maybe ask friends if it helps.
## Open questions
How do I know it helps learning and isn't just telling me answers?

agents2026-demo-b.week-6/README.md:
# Week 6: browser agent
Playwright agent that books a slot on a practice booking page.
Succeeds 7/10 runs. Fails when a date picker opens in a popup.
agents2026-demo-b.week-10/README.md:
# Week 10: single vs multi-agent
| setup | success (20 tasks) | mean cost |
| single agent | 14 | $0.04 |
| navigator + verifier | 17 | $0.11 |
The verifier catches wrong-date bookings. Cost nearly triples.
agents2026-demo-b.final-project/PROPOSAL.md:
# Final project proposal (presented week 8)
## Idea
A browser agent that books shared lab equipment for a research group.
## Plan
Extend the week 6 browser agent; add an approval step before any booking is confirmed.
## Evaluation
30 scripted booking tasks, graded by final calendar state. Report success, cost, and every failure category.
## Open questions
When should it ask the human instead of acting?

agents2026-demo-c.week-7/README.md:
# Week 7: memory
Meeting-notes agent. Ablation on 15 recall questions:
| no memory | 3/15 |
| naive memory | 9/15 |
| selective memory | 12/15 |
Selective memory forgets action items older than two weeks, which was a bug.
agents2026-demo-c.week-9/README.md:
# Week 9: multimodal
Added audio: the agent transcribes a recorded meeting before writing notes.
Speaker attribution is often wrong with more than three speakers.
agents2026-demo-c.final-project/PROPOSAL.md:
# Final project proposal (presented week 8)
## Idea
A memory agent for a small team's meetings: it recalls past decisions when a topic comes up again.
## Plan
Build on weeks 7 and 9.
## Evaluation
Recall questions written by me. Not sure how to test whether it is useful to people other than me.
## Open questions
What should it forget? Who else in the class is working on memory?
